quiz.title: Relational Databases and SQL
quiz.description: Relational database concepts including tables, schemas, keys, normalization, joins, and core SQL for data engineering.

questions.question_text: What does 'relational' mean in the context of a relational database?
questions.option_a: Data is organized into tables with relationships defined via keys
questions.option_b: Data is stored only as key-value pairs
questions.option_d: Data cannot be queried with SQL
questions.correct_answer: Data is organized into tables with relationships defined via keys

questions.option_a: A column or set of columns that uniquely identifies each row in a table
questions.option_c: A password used to log into the database
questions.option_d: A column that is always deleted
questions.correct_answer: A column or set of columns that uniquely identifies each row in a table

questions.question_text: What is a foreign key used for?
questions.option_a: Linking a row in one table to a row in another table
questions.correct_answer: Linking a row in one table to a row in another table

questions.question_text: Which SQL clause is used to filter rows before aggregation?
Which SQL clause filters groups after a GROUP BY aggregation?
What does an INNER JOIN return?
questions.option_a: Only rows that have matching values in both joined tables
questions.option_b: All rows from both tables regardless of match
questions.option_c: Only rows from the left table
questions.correct_answer: Only rows that have matching values in both joined tables

questions.question_text: What is database normalization primarily used to reduce?
Which of these is an example of a relational database management system?
What does the SQL command 'CREATE INDEX' help improve?
questions.option_a: The speed of lookups and queries on a column
questions.option_b: The number of rows in a table
questions.option_c: The color scheme of a database GUI
questions.correct_answer: The speed of lookups and queries on a column

questions.question_text: What is a transaction in a relational database, in the context of ACID properties?
questions.option_a: A unit of work that is executed reliably and treated as a single atomic operation
questions.option_c: A backup of the entire database
questions.correct_answer: A unit of work that is executed reliably and treated as a single atomic operation

questions.question_text: What does the 'A' in ACID stand for?
Which SQL statement is used to combine rows from two queries with the same columns?
What is a common purpose of database schemas in a data warehouse, such as a star schema?
questions.option_a: Organizing fact and dimension tables to optimize analytical queries
questions.correct_answer: Organizing fact and dimension tables to optimize analytical queries
